title: /guides/pour-over/
paragraphs: Pour over coffee rewards patience. Weigh 15 grams of coffee for 250 grams of water.
If you do not want to do the math, our Coffee Ratio Calculator gives you the numbers for any cup size.
A burr grinder keeps the grind even, which matters more than the kettle.
Read the french press guide for a fuller body.

paragraphs: The french press is forgiving: coarse grind, four minutes, and a gentle press. Compared with pour over it needs less technique.

title: /blog/best-grinders/
paragraphs: A good burr grinder is the best upgrade for most home brewers.
Pair it with a scale and the coffee ratio calculator to dial in pour over at home.

title: /blog/coffee-storage/
paragraphs: Store beans away from light. A burr grinder only helps if the beans are fresh.
For pour over, grind right before brewing.
Fresh beans also make the french press ratio easier to dial in.
Even an Aeropress benefits; see the coffee ratio calculator.
A french press needs a coarse grind.
